instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, schedules, sheets, and built-in export commands. Open the provided init.ifc from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc using Revit's Open IFC workflow before editing, and use init_sheet.png as the local visual reference. Modify the starting model into a single-storey kindergarten retrofit layout with an overall 18.0 m by 14.0 m footprint near the project origin. Use real walls, two slabs, and two roof elements, with the wall and roof envelope rising to about 3.4 m. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, six IfcSpace entities, eight IfcWall entities, two IfcSlab entities, two IfcRoof entities, and eight IfcWindow entities. Do not include IfcDoor, IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include Lobby, at least two Classrooms, Nap, Kitchen, and Toilet. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
